description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which serves as a launcher activity managing UI fragments and logging features. It handles UI setup, menu options, toggling log visibility, and initializes logging infrastructure.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends SampleActivityBase, serving as the main launcher activity that manages UI fragments and logging for the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the MediaEffectsFragment if starting fresh.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu items each time the menu is displayed, updates visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log visibility.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, configuring log wrappers, filters, and output to LogFragment.
